name: Odisha Sahaya Scheme - Pre & Post Matric Scholarship
benefit:
1. The students desirous to avail of the scholarship shall submit applications in the prescribed format to the DSSO with certification/ recommendation by the head of the educational institutions.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant is a bona fide resident of Odisha. 1. The applicant is either a beggar or the child of a beggar. 1. The applicant is a regular student of recognised educational institutions. 1. The applicant shall have a family income of not more than ₹ 2,40,000/- per annum. 1. The applicant is not in receipt of any financial assistance from the State Govt./ Central Govt. under any other scheme.
